# Szmelc Conventions

> Global conventions for humans and AI agents: language, git/PR/CI, branch lanes, repo metadata, notifications, verification, subagents, colors, CLI/TUI, Arch/Nix packaging, agent-file formats. Agents load rules lazily: read INDEX.md, then only files whose trigger matches the task.

Entry points: [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/SKILL.md), [INDEX.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/INDEX.md), [index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/index.json). All stable rules in one file: [CONVENTIONS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS.md).

## Always on
- [Szmelc global rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/global/AGENTS.md): Installed as global instructions (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, QWEN.md, …); always active

## Rules
- [Subagents & tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/agents/subagents.md): Load when considering a subagent, parallel work, skills/MCP use, or long-running commands.
- [Colors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/design/colors.md): Load when any UI, TUI, CLI color, web page, theme, badge or graphic.
- [CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/interfaces/cli.md): Load when building or changing a command-line tool.
- [TUI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/interfaces/tui.md): Load when building a TUI, or any project that has a CLI.
- [Agent instruction files](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/meta/agent-files.md): Load when creating or editing AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, QWEN.md, Cursor/Copilot/Kiro/Windsurf rules, or llms.txt in any project.
- [Skills (SKILL.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/meta/skills.md): Load when writing, editing, or installing an agent skill.
- [Stack defaults](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/meta/stack.md): Load when starting a project or tool, or choosing language, dependencies or config format.
- [Arch packaging](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/packaging/arch.md): Load when packaging, releasing, or adding install instructions.
- [Nix packaging](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/packaging/nix.md): Load when packaging, releasing, or setting up a dev environment.
- [Branches & lanes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/workflow/branches.md): Load when creating branches, opening/merging PRs, releasing, or promoting/deprecating a convention.
- [Finish every change](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/workflow/finish.md): Load when finishing a feature or fix, before calling work done.
- [Git, PRs & CI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/workflow/git-pr-ci.md): Load when committing, pushing, opening/merging a PR, or fixing CI.
- [Notifications](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/workflow/notify.md): Load when a job runs > ~10 min, or a failure needs a human.
- [Repo metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/workflow/repo-metadata.md): Load when creating a repo, first push, release, or editing README/manifest/license.
- [Verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/workflow/verification.md): Load when any code change.

## Skills
- [deep](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/skills/deep/SKILL.md): Escalate to deep reasoning for hard problems — architecture and design decisions, cross-cutting refactors, bugs with unclear root cause, security-sensitive code, concurrency, or anything where a wrong first approach is expensive. Use it before writing code for such tasks. Do not use it for routine edits.

## Experimental
- [Localization (en + pl)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/experimental/localization.md): Opt-in only. Load when user opts into experimental conventions, or adds user-facing strings, locales or translations.
- [Meta-grammar ("LEGO everything")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/experimental/meta-grammar.md): Opt-in only. Load when user opts into experimental conventions, or designs tooling that parses, lints or generates from these conventions.
- [Modules (KUR)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/experimental/modules.md): Opt-in only. Load when user opts into experimental conventions, or builds a Kombinat/KUR plugin module.
- [Spec file taxonomy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/experimental/spec-files.md): Opt-in only. Load when user opts into experimental conventions, or designs Szmelc spec files (SZMELC.md, KOMBINAT.md, TEAM.md, MODULE.md, ASSERTIONS.md, POLICY.md, MEMORY.md).
- [Versioning & generations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/experimental/versioning.md): Opt-in only. Load when user opts into experimental conventions, or tags releases / plans a major rewrite.

## Optional

- [CONVENTIONS.md — The Meta-Grammar & "Universal LEGO" Specification (`v2.0` -> `v3.0`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/legacy/drafts/conventions-v3-lego.md): Legacy archive
